early.annotation: If you play frontline. Beam range is short anyway, so you're close enough for it to keep ticking

mid.name: Healbane
mid.annotation: It applies healing reduction, and if you kill someone while they are under this effect, you heal yourself; it’s excellent in team fights (and for hindering champions who heal a lot, like Victor). Keep yourself alive!

mid.name: Rapid Recharge
mid.annotation: Two more grenades and faster charges. For the bomb heavy version of Kelvin

mid.name: Spirit Lifesteal
mid.annotation: Holding Arctic Beam on someone heals you every tick. Grenade damage counts as well

mid.name: Tankbuster
mid.annotation: Upgrade Mystic Burst. Bonus damage on big grenade and beam hits that ignores spirit resist

mid.name: Escalating Exposure
mid.annotation: Core - Once you close Boundless Spirit and Escalating Exposure, you're unstoppable

late.name: Superior Duration
late.annotation: Longer beam, longer Ice Path, longer dome. Best 3.2k on Kelvin right now

late.name: Greater Expansion
late.annotation: Bigger grenade cloud, longer beam, bigger dome. Hits the whole team instead of one guy

late.name: Mystic Reverb
late.annotation: Imbue Frost Grenade. Grenades slow, lifesteal and splash a second hit around the target

late.name: Spirit Burn
late.annotation: Core if there's an enemy who heals and you need to counter them. Luxury in a normal game
